These settings apply to the hosted Workers stack deployed with Alchemy. Supply them through the deployment's Effect configuration and layers. Changes read at startup require a redeploy; [Settings](/docs/settings/) exposes the controls an Admin can change live. The planned Mac self-host setup is separate.

## Model limits

| Setting | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `MODEL_DAILY_TOKEN_BUDGET` | `1000000` | Deployment input and output tokens per UTC day; positive integer. Personal keys have their own provider billing. |
| `MODEL_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS` | `8000` | Most output tokens one call may request; positive integer. |
| `MODEL_MAX_MESSAGES` | `200` | Most messages per call; positive integer. |
| `MODEL_MAX_REQUEST_BYTES` | `196608` | Largest request body; positive integer. |
| `HOSTED_MODEL_ENABLED` | `false` (`true` in Alchemy dev) | Fallback while no Admin has set hosted inference. An Admin's saved choice wins. |
| `MODEL_SPEND_ALERTS` | `true` (`false` in Alchemy dev) | Notify Admins of deployment model spend. |
| `MODEL_SPEND_ALERT_WINDOW` | `15 minutes` | Minimum window between spend alerts; at least one second. |
| `MODEL_RESERVATION_EXPIRY` | `1 hour` | How long an unfinished model reservation lasts. |
| `MODEL_ROLE_TIERS` | Built-in role map | JSON object mapping roles to tier and optional reasoning settings. |
| `TIER_MODELS` | Unset | JSON object of `fast`, `implement` and `hard` model records. |
| `SUMMARY_MODEL` | Unset | JSON model record for the summary role when no Admin set one. |
| `ANSWER_TURN_LIVE_SECONDS` | `30` | Liveness bound for the agent role's current answer. |

Provider credentials are server-held secrets referenced by name. Do not put their values in documentation, client configuration or logs. Personal keys are saved in Settings.

## Sandbox limits

| Setting | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `SANDBOX_COMMAND_MAX_SECONDS` | `3600` | Command time limit, 60 to 3600 whole seconds. Read by the Worker and browser build. |
| `SANDBOX_COMMAND_STEP_WAIT_SECONDS` | `3600` | How long a remote step waits before handing off its command job, 0 to 3600 whole seconds; 0 hands off immediately. |
| `SANDBOX_IDLE_SECONDS` | `900` | Idle time before a branch machine sleeps. Read by the remote flow host. |
| `SANDBOX_INSTANCE` | `standard-1` | Container type: `lite`, `basic`, or `standard-1` through `standard-4`. |
| `SANDBOX_START_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | `150` | Maximum container start time before a failed wake. |
| `SANDBOX_SECRETS` | `false` | Route additional outbound requests through secrets egress. Enable only after validating the deployment's egress setup. |

Awake capacity, capacity per person and the monthly spend alert are stored settings under **Settings → Sandboxes**, separate from these startup settings.

## Bindings

`ELECTRIC_GATEWAY` is an Alchemy Worker service binding, not a URL environment variable. Database, storage and sandbox services are injected by the deployment's layers. Configure these resources in the infrastructure declaration; do not substitute credentials or deployment-specific hostnames into the public source.
